supported.capacity_seconds: output-rate capacity, increased to safe packet bounds when necessary
supported.occupied_seconds: queued source duration, including pending resampler input and excluding latency or underrun zeros
supported.presented_source_frames: integer-rational source position consumed by graph or reader; physical device latency remains host-owned
supported.capture: input-only, no inserted latency padding, explicit overflow counters
supported.playback_eof: finish_stream seals producer; retry until true, then wait for stats.drained
supported.capture_eof: finish_stream seals at next processor boundary; callbacks flush until finished while host drains
supported.pause: callback boundary, preserves queue, no automatic fade
supported.reset: stop_stream discards current generation; start and queue a new generation event
supported.realtime: no callback mutex; preallocated SPSC endpoints/resampler; callback allocator and deallocator guards passed

checks.check: short EOF material through reader and writer
checks.regression: 37-frame 8000->44100 packet contains rendered material and exact counters

checks.check: Bevy ECS in minimal standalone dependency tree

review_fixes: Acquire finished EOF publication fence before reading final produced/accepted counters, then consumption observations.
Validate supported rates, ratios, FFT grain/packet and queue limits before constructing PacketResampler.
Reject extreme or unsupported configurations with no allocation before refusal.
Own a preallocated PacketResamplerBuffer with correct delay-trim src..src+count range; fixed-resample0.13 interleaved storage left silent short EOF packets.
not_qualified: latency calibration or long-run clock drift
native application captures or process reopen
Linux/Windows execution of new CI matrix
